description: Class-level progression table and metadata for Fighter 2024 (source: WotC / SRD).

1.name: Fighting Style
1.description: Choose a fighting style that modifies attacks/damage.

2.name: Second Wind
2.description: Regain hit points as a bonus action.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.description: Choose Defense, Dueling, Great Weapon Fighting, or Two-Weapon Fighting.

features.name: Second Wind
features.description: Bonus Action, 1d10+level. 2 uses, regain on short rest.

features.name: Weapon Mastery
features.description: Choose 3 weapon types to gain mastery properties.

features.name: Action Surge
features.description: One additional action on your turn. Regain on short or long rest. 1 use.

features.name: Tactical Mind
features.description: When you fail an ability check, spend Second Wind use to add 1d10 to potentially turn it to success.

features.name: Fighter Subclass
features.description: Choose your martial archetype: Champion, Battle Master, Eldritch Knight, Psi Warrior, or Rune Knight.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase ability score by 2 or two by 1 each.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: Attack twice instead of once when taking Attack action.

features.name: Tactical Shift
features.description: When activating Second Wind, move up to half speed without provoking OAs.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase ability score by 2 or two by 1 each.
